Aloft is out now in Steam Early Access, and version 1.0 is coming to PC and PlayStation 5 (PS5) in early 2027.

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Séance of Blake Manor is available now on Xbox Game Pass, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2. It is also available on PC via Steam. Check out the console launch trailer for The Séance of Blake Manor for another look at this first-person supernatural detective game.

Set in Victorian Ireland, The Séance of Blake Manor places players in the gumshoes of Private Investigator Declan Ward as they search for the vanished Evelyn Deane at Blake Manor. To further their investigation, they will need to interview and interrogate an eclectic group of suspects to learn more about their motivations and investigate them to unearth hidden clues from their appearance. Recording details, making connections and cross-referencing evidence will be key to uncovering the truth about Blake Manor and the whereabouts of Evelyn Deane.
title: The Seance of Blake Manor - Official Console Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
"I still love you more than I hate you." Watch the Virtue and a Sledgehammer launch trailer for this action-adventure game. Virtue and a Sledgehammer is available now on PC. 

It can be hard to go home again, especially when everyone you knew has been replaced by digital facsimiles wrapped in tin cans. They claim to want to live in peace, but they’re not alive and peace is the furthest thing from your mind. Tear it all down, and maybe come to terms with your own past in the process. If not, at least you took a swing at it.
title: Virtue and a Sledgehammer - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the announcement trailer for Devilcoin, an upcoming coin-flip roguelite horror game. You traded your soul for money, and now the only way out of this occult purgatory is to keep flipping. Bet on heads or tails, collect Artifacts that bend the odds, and hit the score before your flips run out. Devilcoin will be available on PC.
title: Devilcoin - Official Announcement Trailer

Hide from predators, reawaken machines, and outwit living traps as you search for your twin and the truth of your birth. Floralis will be available on PC in Spring 2027. It will also be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X/S in 2027.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Build it. Test it. Battle it! Watch the latest trailer for ShipShaper to see the announcement that a multiplayer update is coming to the standalone creative shipbuilding sandbox game. ShipShaper is built around the freedom to design, experiment, and bring incredible ships to life. The multiplayer update brings ShipShaper's creative shipbuilding and realistic physics together with the chaos of naval battles, allowing players to design their own vessels, put them through their paces and put them to the test against friends.

ShipShaper is available now in Steam Early Access, and the Multiplayer Update will be available on November 19, 2026.
title: ShipShaper - Official Multiplayer Playtest Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Village in the Shade is available now on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and PC. Watch the Village in the Shade launch trailer for the cozy farming game to see charming village life and the unsettling mysteries to discover once the sun goes down. 

Welcome to Kagatsu, a Japanese mountain village with plenty of secrets. In this brand-new, hand-painted farming sim, you'll plant crops, customise your homestead, and befriend a cast of intriguing characters.

Enjoy the peaceful stillness of rural living, whether it's relaxing by the brook, watching the cherry blossoms with your neighbours, or taking a stroll through town. With so many ways to relax, you're sure to feel right at home.

Just make sure to follow a few simple rules: don't talk to strangers, don't leave the village, and, whatever you do, don't go out at night.
title: Village in the Shade - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy, the final installment in the survival-horror trilogy series, is available now on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S. Watch the creepy launch trailer for Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy to see threats you'll face and more. 

A new clue tied to the case of six missing Sicilian girls, including your missing daughter from over a year ago, reopens the investigation. Descend into a nightmare of hidden rooms, buried memories and relentless human Stalkers to rescue her while uncovering the forgotten origins and secrets of the infamous Red Nun.
title: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest trailer for ARC Raiders to see what to expect from Update 2.3.0, which introduces the Soul's Offering Player Project and the new Noxious set for the third-person extraction shooter game. Update 2.3.0 for ARC Raiders is now live.

From the trailer's official description: 

"While the four contradas of Toledo can’t agree on much, one thing they all have in common are the losses they’ve suffered Topside.

As brutal stories from Pendola Pass trickle into the cantinas, Celeste is encouraging members of Speranza to honor the fallen for who they were and the dents they made in ARC’s onslaught.

While each tribute is unique, every Raider who pauses in reverence shares in the Souls Offering. Answer Celeste’s call and make your contribution."

#ARCRaiders #Gaming #IGN
title: ARC Raiders - Official Soul's Offering: New Player Project Trailer

The Treasure Hunters Season is launching on November 1 for Fortnite.

#Fortnite #Gaming #IGN

author: GameTrailers
description: Introducing Ratata, a chaotic four-player co-op physics game where you and three friends play as a gang of animals who owe money to a mafia toad. Choose your animal – complete with its own unique strengths and weaknesses that are best suited to each mission – and then build your garage, get the thing the boss wants, pack the truck, deliver the goods, and do it all while dressed like you're in an '80s crime heist movie. Wishlist Ratata on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5382020/RATATA/
title: Ratata: Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out 10 new minutes of exclusive gameplay led by creative director Louise Blain from Grave Seasons, the upcoming narrative-driven farming sim...that's also part horror game. You'll farm, you'll romance, and you'll investigate to find out who in town is a supernatural serial killer. 
Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3255110/Grave_Seasons/
title: Grave Seasons: 10 Minutes of Developer-Led Gameplay From This Murder Mystery Farming Sim

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this new look at Meadgard, a manic 4 player co-op action-adventure, cooking management game from Oddiko. Embark on a quest to create a tavern worthy of the Aesir gods as you hunt, battle and forage for supplies by day, and when night comes, the fun begins. Serve drinks and food and entertain your guests and stop them tearing the place to pieces. When the doors close, upgrade your tavern to make it the must visit place in Valhalla! 
Meadgard launches in early access on PC (Steam) on November 5th.
title: Meadgard - Official Demo Release Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the announcement trailer for Cold Case, an upcoming point-and-click narrative adventure detective mystery puzzle game. Cold Case will be available on PC via Steam in Q1 2027.

Restore eight cases from the burned house of an Inspector and look for clues. 

The crime scene photos and records have become impossible to read, but as a Cold Case investigator, your deduction and digital forensic skills can reveal what really happened.

Search by keywords. 
Reconstruct the sequence of events. 
Uncover the truth.
title: Cold Case - Official Announcement Trailer

description: Check out the latest trailer for Roco Kingdom, an upcoming free-to-play, cross-platform, open-world creature-collecting RPG. The new trailer showcases Jinies and battles! Roco Kingdom will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), Windows PC, Xbox, PlayStation 5 (PS5), the App Store, and Google Play. The Closed Beta test (Quack Quack Test) begins on October 27, 2026. You can wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4821880/Roco_Kingdom/
